starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.text: To protect this noble knight from the magic of the culinaromancer, you will have to give him a creme brulee.

starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.text: Not just any creme brulee mind you, but a creme brulee supreme!

starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.player: Well that doesn't sound too hard. What's so supreme about a creme brulee supreme?

starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.text: Are you going to constantly ask me questions?

starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.text: I am a fortune-teller, not a cook, and again I would suggest you speak to the cook next door who will be much more helpful on such culinary matters.

starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.text: Although I happen to know that one of the ingredients is the egg of the evil chicken.

starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.player: The evil chicken? Great. He only ever seems to show up when I don't want him to.

starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.text: I believe the wise old man in Draynor has studied the Evil Chicken.

starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.text: I would suggest you speak to him to get you on the right track. And tell him Bubbykins says hi.

starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.text: That is not important right now. Go! Protect Sir Amik from the magic that threatens his life, my spell will only hold so long!

starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze.player: Just give me 5 minutes and I'll be back!

starting-out-inspecting-sir-amik-varze-a.player: Could you give me that recipe again, please?

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.player: Can we talk about what happened in the dining room?

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.text: Wow! You were incredible! The way you defeated the Culinaromancer, you made it seem so easy!

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.player: So... I don't suppose you can remember exactly how I defeated him can you?

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.text: Of course! Which bit can't you remember doing?

steps.player: That white knight... Sir Amik Varze... I can't quite remember how I saved him...
but it was something to do with creme brulee supreme...

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Ah yes! Why, I was so impressed with that recipe you created that I memorised it!

steps.player: Ah, you did, did you? I don't suppose you could refresh my memory about that?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: But of course! It was an unusual dish, an unusual dish indeed! First you blend together, in a pot, some milk and some cream. Then add cornflour to the mixture.

steps.player: Cornflour? How do I... er, how DID I make that then?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Oh, you told me you used sweetcorn in a mill!

steps.player: Really? Weird. Okay, what did I do then?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Then you travelled to the Kharazi Jungle and searched the plants there until you found a vanilla stick, which was then added to the mixture.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: After that you told me that you sought out and killed the fearsome Evil Chicken, to get one of his eggs, which was then mixed with the other ingredients.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Finally you made some cinnamon by grinding the branch of a Dramen Tree and sprinkled it on top of the creme brulee.

steps.player: Sounds easy enough so far. Er, I mean it was easy enough up to that point.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Yes, but then came the impressive part!

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Apparently, a creme brulee supreme needs to be flambed at exactly the right temperature, and the only fire that is hot enough to do this is the breath of a dragon. Luckily, while killing black dragons near the Evil

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Chicken's lair, you came across a method of forcing a dragon to your will so that it would complete the dish, which you then used to protect Sir Amik!

steps.player: I definitely said that I had to kill some black dragons to do that?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Oh yes. You were quite adamant about it. Specifically black dragons. Specifically near the Evil Chicken's lair.

steps.player: Oh yeah... I remember now...

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Did you want a reminder on any other of your brave exploits?

karamja-jungle-searching-the-vanilla-pla.text: You search through the leaves of the vanilla plant.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You need to make some space in your inventory to do that.

finding-the-lair-talking-to-the-wise-old.prompt: What would you like to say?

options.text: Could I have some free stuff, please?
I'd just like to ask you something.

steps.player: I'd just like to ask you something.

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Please do!

options.text: Poison and how to survive it

steps.player: Could you tell me about the Evil Chicken, please?

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: The Evil Chicken! Many are the myths and legends surrounding this foul bird. Some say that it is the result of a mad mage's attempt to summon a demon, others say that it was once a

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: normal chicken that realised how limited its farmyard life was. It threw off its chains and attempted to unite the other chickens in revenge against their human captors.

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: When that failed the Evil Chicken grew angry with its brethren and swore to kill any human or chicken that it ever encountered again!

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: It is whispered that there is a coven of witches that meet, on the night of the full moon in the fabled fairy kingdom, to worship this bird and that they can summon it to do their twisted will!

steps.player: Right, so if you were looking for the chicken where would you go?

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: I would start in the lands of the fairies, possibly there is some truth in the rumours of summoning the chicken there. Actually, I've done further research, it may be around

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: here somewhere, if you're really thinking of going there you should be extremely careful, it's claimed that the chicken has forced some very powerful creatures to guard his lair.

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

steps.prompt: What would you like to say?

steps.player: Yes please.
Thanks, maybe some other time.

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: As you wish. Farewell, [player name].

options.text: Is there anything I can do for you?
Could you check my items for junk, please?

finding-the-lair-using-an-egg-on-the-chi.text: Nice idea, but nothing interesting happens.

finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.text: The dragon's token doesn't seem to work here. Try it in Lumbridge town or Zanaris.

finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.player: What happened? I rubbed that coin and everything went black!

finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.speaker: K'klik
finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.text: Who are you? You're not the hero I gave my token to!

finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.speaker: K'klik
finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.text: How did you get that coin you used to summon me?

finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.player: I took it from the dead body of a black dragon.
I didn't realise what it would do if I rubbed it.
Who, or what, are you anyway?

finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.speaker: K'klik
finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.text: My name is K'klik. I am a Fairy Dragon.

finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.speaker: K'klik
finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.text: One of the last surviving members of my race, I fear.

finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.speaker: K'klik
finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.text: Enough of that: you summoned me, so how can I help?

finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.speaker: K'klik
finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.text: The person who holds my token can summon me by rubbing it.

finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.speaker: K'klik
finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.text: They then have the right to request one thing of me before returning my token.

finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.player: So I can ask one thing of you?

finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.speaker: K'klik
finding-the-lair-rubbing-dragon-token-wh.text: That's right. What do you want?

options.text: Please flambe this creme brulee for me.
options.condition: If the player is holding the brulee:

steps.player: Please flambe this creme brulee for me.

steps.speaker: K'klik
steps.text: Sure, that's easy.
If the player is not wearing ice gloves:

steps.speaker: K'klik
steps.text: I think you need to wear some sort of protective gloves, otherwise I'll flambé your arm.

steps.player: Go ahead, I'll be fine.

steps.speaker: K'klik
steps.text: Okay, if you're sure.
If the player is wearing an anti-dragon shield:
Your shield absorbs most of the dragon fire!
The dragon's token has vanished from your backpack.

options.text: What gloves do you have in mind?

steps.player: What gloves do you have in mind?

steps.speaker: K'klik
steps.text: A pair of ice gloves should do the trick.

steps.player: I'll go fetch them then.

options.text: Could I just keep your token for when I really need it, please?

steps.player: Could I just keep your token for when I really need it, please?

steps.speaker: K'klik
steps.text: I suppose that seems fair. Alright, just call me when you need me.

options.text: Can I wish for some xp?

steps.player: Can I wish for some xp?

steps.speaker: K'klik
steps.text: Sorry, can't help. You'll have to ask the genie for that.

steps.player: I'd like a horse, please.

steps.speaker: K'klik
steps.text: No horses in Gielinor. Try again.

assembling-the-brulee-using-milk-with-a-.text: You mix the pot of cream and the milk together.

assembling-the-brulee-using-cournflour-o.text: You mix the cornflour into the milk and cream mixture.

assembling-the-brulee-using-vanilla-pod-.text: You add the vanilla pod to the brulee mixture.

assembling-the-brulee-using-evil-egg-on-.text: You mix in the Evil Chicken's egg.

assembling-the-brulee-using-pestle-and-m.text: You grind the branch into powder.

assembling-the-brulee-using-cinnamon-on-.text: You sprinkle cinnamon on top of the brulee mixture. Now it just needs flambeing.

assembling-the-brulee-emptying-the-brule.prompt: Are you sure you want to empty that pot?

steps.text: You empty the contents of the pot onto the floor.

finishing-up-using-the-brulee-supreme-on.text: Congratulations, you have saved Sir Amik Varze.
(Continues with Aris dialogue after freeing a council member.)
